note: Rules frozen after the last session used in research (2026-11-03 close). Only sessions AFTER this date count as forward evidence. Do not edit these files; change = new freeze folder with a new date.

strategies.N1: new_strategies.s_voltarget: S&P exposure 15%/21d realized vol, cap 2x via SSO, 10-pt band, next-open fills, 3 bp/side
strategies.T2: backtest.make_tsmom(TREND_SET): 10-ETF 12-1m + 200d SMA, monthly, 3 bp/side (hindsight-picked list, kept to see if it holds)
strategies.I1b: intraday.i1(levered=True): SPY noise boundary, 2% daily-vol sizing <=4x, 0.5 bp/side

review_rules.kill: drop a strategy if forward max DD exceeds 1.5x its 2017-2026 backtest max DD (N1 -19.4%, T2 -8.4%, T2r -8.0%, I1b -31.2%, I2b -30.0%)
review_rules.graduate: only after 252 forward sessions: forward Sharpe (xs T-bill) above SPY's AND forward avg trade / return consistent with backtest sign. One year cannot prove an edge; it can reject a broken one.
